en.title: Synology DSM SSOAuth and other feature flaws allow authorization bypass and file access
en.summary: Several flaws in different features of Synology DSM let logged-in users or remote attackers read or write arbitrary files and stop services. Versions before the fixed releases in DSM 7.2, 7.3 and 7.4 are affected.
conditions: Some flaws need a valid DSM user account
One needs a compromised LDAP or Active Directory server
easy_conditions: Some need a DSM login account
Some need a hijacked company account server
en.mitigation: Update DSM 7.4 to 7.4.1-90080-1 or later, DSM 7.3 to 7.3.2-86009-5 or later, and DSM 7.2 to 7.2.2-72806-10 or 7.2.1-69057-13 or later.
en.easy: Synology NAS software could let attackers steal or stop your files!
en.easy_action: Update DSM to a fixed version.

cve_lines.text: An authenticated user can manipulate an access key to read or write arbitrary files or stop services.
A logged-in user can use the sharing feature to read or write files outside the restricted folder.
A logged-in user can exploit a missing authentication step to read or write arbitrary files.
An attacker with valid credentials can bypass authentication through another path to read or write arbitrary files.
A logged-in user can manipulate a link to write arbitrary files.
An attacker controlling a compromised LDAP or Active Directory server can manipulate database commands to read or write arbitrary files.
A remote attacker can stop the NFS service through an uninitialized pointer access.
An administrator-level user can exploit an OS command flaw in the VPN feature to read or write arbitrary files.
An administrator-level user can exploit a CRLF flaw in SNMP handling to read or write arbitrary files.
A remote attacker without login can read specific files through WebDAV and limitedly stop some services.
A logged-in user can manipulate file paths in the media parser to write arbitrary files.
A logged-in user can read arbitrary files because the API sends sensitive information.
A man-in-the-middle attacker can read arbitrary files and write specific files while a support form is submitted.
A remote authenticated user can read or write specific files by exploiting an input handling flaw in the Audio Player.
A remote authenticated user can read or write specific files because the ACL API lacks an authorization check.
A remote authenticated user can read or write specific files by exploiting an input handling flaw in DSMNotify.
A remote authenticated user can read or write specific files by exploiting an input handling flaw in the Notification API.
A remote attacker can read specific files because of incorrect authorization in Security Advisor.
A remote attacker can trigger a limited denial-of-service attack through a reachable assertion in synoscgi.
A remote authenticated user can write specific files because the Promotion API lacks an authorization check.
A remote authenticated user can read specific files because contentextract does not properly restrict pathnames.
A remote authenticated user can read specific files through a server-side request forgery flaw in the Credential API.
A remote authenticated user can write specific files because the SocketIo API lacks an authorization check.
A remote authenticated user can write specific files because the TaskScheduler API lacks an authorization check.
A remote authenticated user can write specific files by exploiting externally controlled settings in synomount.
A remote attacker can read specific files, write arbitrary files, and launch a limited denial-of-service attack by bypassing authentication in rsync.
A remote attacker can read or write arbitrary files and launch a denial-of-service attack by exploiting an SQL command handling flaw in the Auth API.

ko.mitigation: FortiOS 8.0은 8.0.2, 7.6은 7.6.8, 7.4는 7.4.13, 7.2는 7.2.14 이상으로 업데이트하세요. FortiOS 7.0(7.0.1~7.0.19)은 advisory가 고친 릴리스로 옮기라고 합니다. FortiPAM은 CVE 기록의 1.9.3, 1.8.5, 1.7.3 이상 버전으로 올리세요. FortiSASE는 제조사가 이미 고쳐서 따로 할 일이 없습니다.
ko.easy: 포티넷 방화벽 장비가 해킹당하거나 멈출 수 있습니다!

cve_lines.text: 인증 없는 공격자가 특수하게 만든 요청으로 OSPF 경로 정보를 네트워크에 뿌릴 수 있습니다.
설정된 iBGP 이웃 장비가 잘못된 값을 보내 연결된 라우터들에 문제를 일으킬 수 있습니다.
인증하지 않은 공격자가 특수하게 만든 자격 정보로 로그인 검사를 통과할 수 있습니다. FortiPAM도 해당합니다.
원격의 권한 있는 공격자가 조작된 패킷으로 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

en.title: FortiOS and FortiPAM authentication bypass and code execution flaws
en.summary: Four flaws in Fortinet FortiOS and FortiPAM allow authentication bypass, arbitrary command execution and router disruption. Some can be triggered by an unauthenticated attacker.
easy_conditions: A device registered as a routing neighbor in its settings
en.mitigation: Update FortiOS 8.0 to 8.0.2, 7.6 to 7.6.8, 7.4 to 7.4.13 and 7.2 to 7.2.14 or later. For FortiOS 7.0 (7.0.1 through 7.0.19), the advisory says to migrate to a fixed release. For FortiPAM, update to 1.9.3, 1.8.5 or 1.7.3 or later as the CVE record states. FortiSASE was fixed by the vendor; users need do nothing.
en.easy: Fortinet firewall devices can be hacked or knocked offline!
en.easy_action: Update your Fortinet device to the fixed version.

cve_lines.text: An unauthenticated attacker can flood the network with OSPF routing information using a specially crafted request.
A configured iBGP neighbor can send bad values that cause problems for all connected routers.
An unauthenticated attacker can pass the login check with specially crafted credentials. FortiPAM is also affected.
A remote attacker with privileges can run arbitrary commands using crafted packets.

cve_texts.CVE-2026-126253: A authentication bypass by primary weakness vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiOS 7.4.0 through 7.4.12, FortiOS 7.2.0 through 7.2.13 may allow an unauthenticated attacker to broadcast LSA via specially crafted request
cve_texts.CVE-2026-126254: A numeric truncation error vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiOS 7.4.0 through 7.4.12, FortiOS 7.2.0 through 7.2.13 may allow a configured ibgp neighbor to send malicious/malformed attributes to all connected routers via a specially crafted request
cve_texts.CVE-2026-126255: A path traversal: '../filedir' vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiOS 7.4.0 through 7.4.12, FortiOS 7.2.0 through 7.2.13, FortiPAM 1.6 all versions, FortiPAM 1.5 all versions, FortiPAM 1.4 all versions, FortiPAM 1.3 all versions, FortiPAM 1.2 all versions, FortiPAM 1.1 all versions, FortiPAM 1.0 all versions may allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication via specially crafted credentials.
cve_texts.CVE-2026-126256: A out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiOS 7.4 all versions, FortiOS 7.2 all versions, FortiOS 7.0 all versions may allow a remote privileged attacker to execute arbitrary code or command via crafted paquets.
